verdict.rationale: Kick is a cloud bookkeeping service, and self-hosting is a fair question to ask of such a product, so the axis applies. Every piece of evidence describes a hosted product: a hosted API at use.kick.co, Plaid connections and hosted MCP/CLI access. Nothing documents a self-hostable deployment of the core product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
